SELECT CASE WHEN $3 = '' THEN nucleo.agente_falhou($4, $7, nullif($5, ''), $2)
  ELSE nucleo.agente_registrar(nullif($1, '')::int, $2, $3, $4, nullif($5, ''), nullif($6, '')) END AS r

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [String($('Lote pronto').first().json.cliente_id || ''), $('Lote pronto').first().json.chatInput, $json.output || '', $('Lote pronto').first().json.agente, String($('Lote pronto').first().json.numero || ''), $('Lote pronto').first().json.nome || '', (typeof $json.error === 'string' ? $json.error : ($json.error && ($json.error.message || JSON.stringify($json.error)))) || 'a IA nao devolveu resposta'] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO nucleo.whatsapp_enviadas (id) SELECT unnest(string_to_array(nullif($1, ''), ',')) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

SELECT nucleo.whatsapp_saida($1::int, $2, $3, string_to_array(nullif($4, ''), ',')),
  CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN nucleo.registrar_evento('leo', 'erro', nucleo.motivo_erro($5), $5, jsonb_build_object('numero', $2, 'canal', 'whatsapp')) END AS evento,
  CASE WHEN $6 <> '' THEN nucleo.registrar_evento('leo', 'aviso', 'Nao consegui entregar no WhatsApp: ' || nucleo.motivo_erro($6), $6, jsonb_build_object('numero', $2)) END AS aviso
